title: Fuor la spada: scegliete
subtitle: Guglielmo, Don Alfonso and Ferrando: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 1, recitative after No. 1
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score ('la, sciegliete, perchè, Dee).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 12–13, the recitative between No. 1 and No. 2 (25 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (one rhythm in bar 17 corrected, then clean); the print has no dynamics or expression marks here. Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words, the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation, the “Cont./Cemb.” cues and the direction “(gelassen)” are left out. The last bar is printed as a half bar (attacca No. 2). Playback tempo ♩ = 93, a nominal speaking pace for secco recitative, from the lengths of three complete recordings (Böhm 1962, Jacobs, Gardiner 1993; median 1:03); Mozart gives no tempo.
